name: tally
display_name: tally — Product Analytics / Feature Flags / Experiments Employee
description: The product-analytics + feature-flags + experiments employee — count what matters, once, correctly, and refuse to ship the silent-failure no alert will ever catch: a CI-gated event registry that fails the build on a case-variant event, OpenFeature flags wired DB-eval-or-pinned-props (never bare local-eval), PII masked at the edge, and SRM-first / peeking-impossible experiments that won't ship a fake winner. Product analytics only — LLM token spend is agentmoney's, app health is canary's, web stats are the Plausible plane. Powered by Energy.
author: Energy Platform
install_instructions:
1. Install deps and build: pnpm install && pnpm build
2. Add this plugin to Claude Code: Settings -> Plugins -> Add local plugin -> select this directory (or `claude plugin install tally`).
3. The tally CLI, the tally MCP server (track_plan / wire_flag / capture_event / check_experiment / audit_pii / flag_sweep / migrate_plan / explain / search_brain), the 5 skills, the commit-gate hook (blocks $set-on-acquisition / case-variant events / reused flag keys / maskAllInputs:false / un-allowlisted PII keys / gen_ai.usage into PostHog), and the taxonomy-pii-auditor + experiment-stats-reviewer sub-agents are now available.
